类 StringVector

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.sun.org.apache.xml.internal.utils.StringVector
  • 所有已实现的接口:
    Serializable

    public class StringVector
extends Object
implements Serializable
    A very simple table that stores a list of strings, optimized for small lists.
